chapter: South America and back in New York
title: Harlem clubs he dropped in on
summary: He names Connie's Inn, Goldgraben's, Edmunds, Connors, Happy Rhone's and the Atlantis Club and after-hours spots.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: So what were some of the places that you dropped in on, for instance.

Well, there was like Connies Inn, sometimes. And there was Goldgraben's around there. And Edmunds had a place and Connors had a place there on 135th Street, and Edmunds was on 5th Avenue. And there was -- Happy Rhone's was over there where the Cotton Club was eventually put up there. And later on, Jeff Brunt had a place, the Atlantis Club, right next to that. Oh, there was quite a lot of places. And then there was some after hours places. I didn't bother about playing in them, but we used to go to them when we had to convince a young lady that she should be with us. We would go into there setting there and to convince her by pouring some liquor into her and talking to her. We used to do that too, quite often.
